notes.title: Leaderboard Reset Updates
notes.content: [p]Hello Golfing Gladiators,[/p][p][/p][p]You almost certainly noticed the lack of updates and leaderboard resets the past few months. Here is a post explaining why, and what changes are happening going forward.[/p][p]Why the lack of updates and leaderboard resets? I'm busy, and only got busier. So to combat this, there will be two main changes, both of which kinda already happened[/p][olist][*][p]Leaderboards are moving from monthly to quarterly. The overall leaderboards remain unchanged, its only the resetting ones that will have their reset timings change[/p][/*][*][p]The highlighted levels will be ceasing. Their intended goal was to foster friendly competition in the community, and they unfortunately failed at doing so. They are not closed for good though, if there is interest revival is possible.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]And lastly, a team update (no, nothing bad): The Hippos are continuing to plug away at our next title, though in general we all have been busier so progress has been slow. We will share more when we are ready, which has no timeline - this is a fun hobby project for us, and life does take priority. With that said, we are not dead (despite our artist(s) best attempts at murder via Baby Shark), there is still something in the works, just don't expect anything in the way of communication about it.[/p][p][/p][p] Happy golfing! [/p][p]- Auri[/p]

notes.title: Fred's Patch Notes - v1.5.0
notes.content:
Hello Ballin Golfers,

The long awaited, the mythical, the foretold, METEOR BASKETBALL HAS ARRIVED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! And some other quality of life fixes, nothing major.

[list]
[*] Meteor Basketball! Find this wonderful new gamemode under the "Minigames" section on Level Select! Also, make sure to play the tutorial so you know how it works.
[*] Time slow mechanic! A Meteor Basketball exclusive, slow down the time (but not the timer!) to more perfectly line up your shots
[*] No more replays in the tutorials. You know how you could race specific replays in the tutorial levels? Well, no more! Those levels, and Meteor Basketball ones, no longer have any leaderboard-based replays available.
[/list]

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
This is the last planned update for Disaster Golf. After 3 years of development (yes, that long, and including the process of taking the game out of university), we will be putting Disaster Golf on the backburner. Future updates are not impossible, but they will be as members of the team decide to make them, without a strict release timeframe or schedule.

Rest assured, the Hippos causing Havoc are not going away! We have started a new project, one that will be sure to excite! No, nothing else is getting said about that. Any more and our artist(s) will find me, and they will force me to listen to Baby Shark on loop for a week straight.

Happy golfing!
- Auri

notes.title: Publisher Update
notes.content:
Hello Archie Attackers,

If you have been keeping a close eye, and I mean very close, on the Steam page recently you may have noticed a few changes. Unfortunately, Disaster Golf's publisher, VoxPop Games, is closing. Hippo Havoc will be self-publishing Disaster Golf going forward.

What does this mean for the game and for you, the players? For the game, nothing unplanned will be happening. We have one more update in the pipeline, then Disaster Golf will be going into a stasis state. As members of the team want to work on it, we will, but no planned updates will be coming out after the next one. I want to reiterate, this is not a result of VoxPop's closure. This was planned before. We will be leaving the VoxPop splash screen in as a thank you to them for all the help.

For you, the players: almost nothing will be changing. If you need support, contact us (Hippo Havoc) via the details on the Steam page instead of VoxPop. Everything else will remain the same.

VoxPop helped us in more ways than just marketing or publishing. They provided advice on navigating the indie games space, they were constantly telling us why they were doing certain things to make sure we knew for the future, and most importantly, they were our friends. Without VoxPop, neither Disaster Golf nor Hippo Havoc would be where they are today.

We would like to shout out the people we worked with directly as a show of thanks and to help boost visibility for their future endeavors:

Connor Riley ([url=https://www.connorrileymedia.com/]https://www.connorrileymedia.com/[/url])
Connor was part of the original university team that created Disaster Golf. He is responsible for the level Change of Scenery, so if you enjoy that level, now you know who made it! Also, if you played the beta and alpha versions of the level - those being the ones developed during university in 2021 - we sincerely apologize (though I still think they were neat - Auri). Connor is the one who brought VoxPop onto our radar, and he was the main force behind content like livestreams and the "How-To" shorts on the VoxPop YouTube channel.

Marc Anthony Rodriguez ([url=https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcarodriguez/]https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcarodriguez/[/url])
Marc was our primary point of contact after Connor introduced us. He was the one actually doing the marketing, getting us in contact with the press, and a million other things all at once. How he had time for anything, the world will never know. Marc was the silent force keeping the game moving forward and ensuring that people - like you! - knew about it.

And know that anyone we didn't list is awesome too! We just didn't work with them directly.

Happy Golfing,
- Hippo Havoc (Auri, TJ, Kyle, Ash)

notes.title: Fred's Patch Notes - v1.4.0
notes.content:
Hello Lightning Blasters,

It's finally time: those things in the works from Update 1.3.0 are finally here! Those things, those changes and features as majestic as Margaret, what are they? They are as follows:

[list]
[*] New songs! The game's original composer, Xavier Chapman, is back with two new tracks! Find them on any Jungle or Volcano level, there is a 50/50 shot you get it each time you play a level.
[*] New sounds! Scrolling the leaderboard too dull and soundless? Now it clicks! Finding a David not give enough feedback? Now there's a sound for that! Those and many more, now in Disaster Golf!
[*] New species have been discovered across the courses! Find the not-so-elusive long neck hippo in the Jungle, or the significantly more elusive baby dinosaur in the Volcano. Also our artist's thirst for vengeance is sated. Somewhat.
[/list]

[h1]Original Soundtrack[/h1]
That's right folks, Disaster Golf now has its OST for sale! Get some sick tunes to golf/destroy the world to today, including one never-before-heard (definitely not because we forgot to implement it years ago...) song. Hats off and major thanks to our composer, Xavier Chapman, for their wonderful work!

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Tutorials: the undisputed most fun part of any game. And now, we have a brand new one to share! Presenting, the Meteor Basketball tutorial (minus any art, our artist has been ravaging a countryside and clearing it of any and all hippos)
[previewyoutube=jrg9DFpG-aU;full][/previewyoutube]
Before you say it, yes I know whoever is playing (definitely NOT myself, nope, never) is not that great at the mode. I'm workin on it.

Happy golfing!
- Auri

notes.title: Fred's Patch Notes - v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hello Arching Archaeoperteri,

I hope Archaeopteri is the plural of Archaeopteryx, it certainly sounds the best out of the various versions. Now, down to business, there's been another update! What does this one bring? New things, of course! Specifically:

[list]
[*] Monthly Leaderboards! This will have its own entire section below, see that for details. Just know our artist made new icons, and seems to be appeased by this development.
[*] Level geometry fixes. You can't escape your teenage math years, next up will be level trigonometry! Yes, math, not maths.
[*] Some backend prepwork for a future update. This may result in slightly longer leaderboard submissions.
[*] Minor bugfixes. If you notice any bugs, please report them on our Discord server ([url=https://discord.gg/UNApuJcyxr]https://discord.gg/UNApuJcyxr[/url])!
[/list]

[h1]Monthly Leaderboard[/h1]
Would you look at that, there is a whole new leaderboard in the game. Well, technically 36 whole new leaderboards, but that's a small detail.

Every level has a leaderboard that will be reset monthly. This is the new default leaderboard shown when selecting a level. Don't worry, the global leaderboards haven't gone anywhere. They are still accessible via a tab similar to the friends-only tab, and have not changed. I repeat: [b]Monthly Leaderboards are the new default view, but the global leaderboards still exist and will be submitted to the same.[/b]

In addition to monthly leaderboards for every level, we would like to so something to highlight specific levels for people to compete in. So, each month we will make a Community Post (both here and on the Discord) specifying which levels are the focus for that month. And with each one of these, we will shout out the top players from the previous month's highlighted levels.

March's monthly leaderboards are starting now, have an extra two days! The highlighted levels for March 2024 are:
[list]
[*] Island Hopping
[*] Lava Falls
[/list]

In addition to monthly leaderboards, we have a speedrun.com page! Well, we've had one since launch but kept forgetting to say something about it. The page is for entire game speedruns, so from Sweet Beginnings all the way through to Pyramid Scheme, the entire time counts! Check it out at [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Disaster_Golf_]https://www.speedrun.com/Disaster_Golf_[/url]

[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Development update time! Did someone say Meteor Basketball news? Even if no one did, you are getting some pre-alpha footage anyway:
[previewyoutube=Gvt-88lRM6c;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy golfing!
- Auri

notes.title: Fred's Patch Notes - v1.1.0
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Friends-only filter for the leaderboard! See which of your friends is the fastest, and compete with them, and only them! Note that scores will still appear on the global leaderboard, and your global rank will be shown
[img]https://cdn.myportfolio.com/c306d464-200f-491b-9cc2-68b661455800/5a5540c7-84ae-4d8d-b06d-47ba631b7ef5_rw_600.png?h=83d774308f6feffec5dd19348f2c7e4e[/img]

[*] New disaster help button. When hovering over a disaster in the selection screen, a new "?" button appears in the top right corner. Click it to see what that disaster does!

notes.title: Post-Launch News and General Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello Geyser Riders,

Its been a fun few days! Disaster Golf released, and we have been blown away by the amount of support the game has gotten. Truly, thank you for giving it a shot, and we all hope you have even more fun to come.

[h1]How To Video Series[/h1]
Struggling to get that top leaderboard spot, or just looking for some tips to help you complete each level? We've got just the thing for you - the Disaster Golf How To videos! From the basics of how each disaster works to important speed running tricks, you'll find it all in our 3-part series. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EHkHx7chIvk]DIsaster Basics[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zgb_fZuTEb0]Comboing[/url], and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hPYZcs8JH54]Speedrunner Tips[/url]

Now, down to business. And by business, I mean where is Fred going next (don't turn around). We have a few things planned, here they are!

[h1]Bugfix and Quality of Life Update[/h1]
Ever finish an essay, turn it in, then notice all the grammar and spelling mistakes? Yea, its nowhere near that bad, but there are things to improve! We have been hard at work collecting, fixing, and creating new bugs! That last part is only partially a joke, we have some new quality of life features inbound, and with new things inevitably come new bugs. Our target date for this update is Febuary, as its contents get finalized I'll be sure to let y'all know!

Here's a sneak peak at one of them:
[previewyoutube=leqVQR65sHc;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Meteor Basketball[/h1]
Standard Disaster Golf too boring, too predictable, too golf-like for you? Try Meteor Basketball! A brand new gamemode where your only goal is shooting hoops and dunking golf balls. Use the meteor, and only the meteor, to perfectly calculate your angle and give that ball nothing but net.

This is still in early development, as we progress more information and screenshots will be shared.

Happy golfing!

- Auri

notes.title: Disaster Golf is live... Now!
notes.content:
Hello Archaeopteryx Annihilators,

Welcome to the chaotic world of [i]Disaster Golf[/i]! Fling your ball across the map with any disaster you choose (though you might not get that far using Wind or Sandstorm), and avoid the hungry hippos along the way.

It has been a long time coming, but [i]Disaster Golf[/i] is finally out. From a year of development as a university capstone project and almost two years after, its been a long and crazy ride. Thank you to everyone who helped and showed us support on the path to this historical, world-changing moment (yes, we will be naming specific names a bit later, you can't escape). Coming into this, we never expected to be launching a full game, and having a publisher on top is even more unbelievable. VoxPop has been incredibly helpful in navigating the waters of marketing, and has made the process of getting the last mile in a whole lot smoother.

Our favorite things about the game have to be to be Fred, Fred, and Fred. In that order specifically. In all seriousness, we put a ton of time and effort into creating a zany, chaotic world to play in, and we hope that you find it just as crazy as we do. The disasters offer a lot of room to explore; we can't wait to see what combinations y'all come up with! Use those combinations, and other tricks you pick up, to climb the leaderboard and claim that top spot.

A massive thank you (see, told ya you can't escape) to everyone who helped make [i]Disaster Golf[/i] possible along the way! Including (but not limited to) our capstone team members, professors, VoxPop peeps, and others who know who they are. There are too many of you to list in a single blog post, so here is a [url=https://hippohavoc.com/about]link[/url] with all your names on it! Also don't forget to check the credits of the game - everyone there played a massive role in the creation of this earth-shattering masterpiece.

With the most sincerity possible,
Happy golfing!

- The entire Hippo Havoc team (Auri, Ash, TJ, Kyle)

notes.title: DISASTER GOLF - AN INDIE SPEEDRUNNER’S DREAM LAUNCHES FREE DEMO ON 1/16
notes.content:
Get Ready for some Environmental Mayhem driving Golf Balls through Madcap Worlds a Plenty, with the [b]Hippo Havoc Team[/b] & [b]VoxPop Games[/b]!!!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44641012/0abd13ddc024dd6314ceb100e0f7057a7af2146c.png[/img]

[b]BROOKLYN, NEW YORK - JANUARY 8, 2023[/b] – [i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i], a natural disaster physics based sports hybrid game from developer [url=https://hippohavoc.com/]Hippo Havoc LLC[/url] is confirmed by publisher [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/VoxPopGames]VoxPop Games, Inc.[/url] to be coming soon to PC via Steam. 

A free, brand-new playable [b]demo[/b] is going to be released one week prior to launch on [i][b]January 16th, 2024.[/b][/i]
 
Watch the [i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i] Gameplay & How-To Trailer below:

How-to #1: [previewyoutube=EHkHx7chIvk;full][/previewyoutube]
Reveal Trailer: [previewyoutube=_9rBkuYQPyY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i] was the capstone project from the Bradley University Game Design class of 2022 and was continued by a core group of student’s post-graduation, who have formed the brand-new Hippo Havoc development team. 

[i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i] is a fast paced “mini” golf game where players use different disasters to move the ball. The Disaster differs widely, you can throw a Meteor to blast the golf ball across the screen or use wind as a putter to gently tap the ball into the hole.

The Par system works a little differently in [i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i]. Instead of strokes, Disaster Golf measures par by your time and even includes an online leaderboard to track everyone’s times. This means that you can compete for World Records on each individual level. Good luck though because the competition will be fierce.

[i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i] will be available on Steam on Tuesday, January 23rd for just [b]$1.99 USD[/b]. Make sure that you [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2575960/Disaster_Golf/]Wishlist the game today![/url][/b]

[u][i][b]Disaster Golf Gameplay Features:[/b][/i][/u]
 
[b]Fast-paced golf! [/b]- No need to wait for your ball to stop moving - hit it again as soon as you can. Disaster Golf is all about speed and getting the ball into the hole as fast as possible using any means available. Combine your natural disasters to get the fastest time! 

[b]Leaderboards and replays![/b] - See how your times stack up on each level using our leaderboards! Want to improve your time? Activate the ghost ball to see exactly how they got that speedy world record time or compare against the world record or your personal best time in race mode!

[b]Multiple level themes![/b] - Golf across biomes! Use meteors in the sand of a beach, suck the ball into a jungle singularity, or shoot it into the sky on a geyser of lava. Explore the beautiful worlds of Disaster Golf!

[b]Challenge mode![/b] - Tired of choosing your own disasters? Let us do that for you. Replay any level in its challenge mode using carefully selected, preset disasters to bring about a unique way of playing. Each challenge mode variant of a level has its own leaderboard - can you devise the best strategy with the disasters you're given and take the top spot?

[b]Hippos![/b] - Hippos here, hippos there, hippos everywhere! Looking to follow Fred's noble quest to overthrow the evil hippo god? Just here for golf? We've got you covered either way.
 
# # #
 
Shatter, smash, boost, and zap lightning bolts as you fight against the world records and hurdle toward victory (and Par in under 30 seconds) in the new Steam demo of Disaster Golf coming January 16th, 2024.

For more information on [b]VoxPop Games[/b], follow on [url=https://twitter.com/VoxPopGames?ref_src=twsrc%5Egoogle%7Ctwcamp%5Eserp%7Ctwgr%5Eauthor]X (fka Twitter)[/url], and visit us on the official [url=https://www.voxpopgames.com/]VoxPop Games website[/url].

Editors interested in covering [i][b]Disaster Golf[/b][/i] can email Marc Anthony Rodriguez (marc@voxpopgames.com).

notes.title: Pricing and Publisher Update
notes.content:
Hello Fred Fanatics,

No game update this time, instead its a community update. 

[h1]Publisher Changes[/h1]
If you have been watching the store page closely, you may have noticed something: there are now two names listed as the publisher. Hippo Havoc has partnered with [url=https://www.voxpopgames.net/]VoxPop Games[/url] to help market the game! We decided to make this partnership for a few reasons:
[olist]
[*]Reach a wider audience. VoxPop can help us reach more people than we could alone.
[*]Expertise in marketing. Hippo Havoc is a new studio of four people, and we don't have experience marketing yet. This partnership will help us gain an understanding of marketing, and improve our own for the future.
[*]We know the people. One of our original team members now works at VoxPop, so we can trust they have our best interests in mind.
[/olist]
[h1]Pricing changes[/h1]
With this new partnership, Disaster Golf will be getting a pricing change. Instead of Free to Play, we will be releasing Disaster Golf at a price point of $1.99. If you already have a beta key, you will NOT lose access. This will allow the game to be featured in Steam's sales and festivals, you can't put a discount on a free game!

[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
We have a community Discord server! Come join and revel in the hippos, post golf memes, or just chill out. The invite link is here: [url=https://discord.gg/UNApuJcyxr]https://discord.gg/UNApuJcyxr[/url]

[h1]Future Communications[/h1]
Communications about the game will be going out in two places: here, and the Discord server above. Every update or major event will be posted to both. Platform-specific things, like a Discord event will be posted exclusively to that channel.

These updates will also start getting signed! They are something to be proud of, and knowing whom is communicating can help build the trust we are striving for. That said, whether the signature uses a screen name or real name will depend on the author(s) level of comfort putting that out there. It will remain consistent per author. So, starting with this post, look for the signatures at the bottom!

Happy golfing!

- Auri

notes.title: Playtesting Notes
notes.content:
First off, thank you for playtesting our game! We have been working hard for the past year, and finally seeing the game not only on Steam, but being played and enjoyed by yall is wonderful. Now, on to the actual notes:

[olist]
[*]The achievements are not earnable during the playtest. They will be for full launch, but we are still working on implementing and arting them.
[*]Sometimes the ghost ball or race mode against the world record may not load. This is likely due to downloading the replay files from the workshop taking a while. If this occurs, please note down what you were doing and include it in your feedback form
[*]We are not planning on resetting the leaderboards before the full launch. We will update you here if that changes.
[*]Our anticipated release date is late November. Some of you may have heard late October/early November before, we decided to push that back to allow for more time to integrate Steam, polish the levels, and include feedback from this playtest.
[*]If you know people who may like the game, please show them the Steam page! This playtest is limited to people we know, but you can turn their eyes to the game for full launch
[/olist]

Happy golfing!
